content.value_statement: Teams must handle EU personal data with clear controls and auditable processes. This skill gives practical patterns for consent, data rights, retention, privacy design, and breach response.
actual_capabilities: Explains GDPR personal data categories and lawful processing bases.
Provides consent management patterns with audit history and preference controls.
Shows data subject access, erasure, and portability request workflows.
Defines retention policy examples with deletion, archiving, and anonymization options.
Includes privacy-by-design data modeling and data minimization examples.
Outlines breach notification steps and GDPR compliance checklist items.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or replace review by qualified counsel.
Uses illustrative code that needs adaptation before production deployment.
Does not validate jurisdiction-specific requirements outside the provided GDPR guidance.
Does not run automated compliance scans or connect to live systems.

use_cases.title: Design Consent Controls
use_cases.description: Plan consent records, preference UI behavior, and audit logging for analytics or marketing purposes.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers building user-facing privacy settings

use_cases.title: Implement Data Subject Requests
use_cases.description: Map access, erasure, and portability workflows with deadlines, verification, and response records.

use_cases.title: Review Privacy Architecture
use_cases.description: Check retention rules, minimization choices, breach response steps, and documentation gaps against GDPR expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Basic GDPR Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a planned feature that processes personal data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my feature plan for GDPR basics. Identify personal data, lawful basis, consent needs, retention, and user rights.

prompt_templates.title: Design Consent Management
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate design for cookie or preference controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design consent management for analytics and marketing. Include data model fields, UI behavior, audit logs, and withdrawal handling.

prompt_templates.title: Build DSAR Workflows
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced implementation planning for privacy operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create access, erasure, and portability workflows. Include verification, deadlines, exceptions, audit records, and response contents.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Privacy Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced compliance review of an existing system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit my privacy architecture. Review data minimization, retention, encryption, breach notification, processors, and documentation gaps.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team asks how to add cookie consent and preference history.
output: Recommended separate consent purposes for necessary, analytics, and marketing processing.
Suggested consent records with timestamp, source, policy version, and audit events.
Outlined withdrawal behavior and links to privacy and cookie policy pages.

output_examples.input: A support team needs a plan for access and erasure requests.
output: Defined request intake, identity verification, response deadlines, and escalation points.
Separated access, erasure, and portability steps with records for each data source.
Listed legal retention exceptions and evidence needed for audit trails.

output_examples.input: A compliance lead wants a privacy-by-design review before launch.
output: Identified high-risk personal data fields and suggested minimization changes.
Mapped retention periods to legal bases and business purposes.
Highlighted breach response, encryption, access control, and processor documentation gaps.

best_practices: Document the lawful basis, retention period, and processing purpose before collecting personal data.
Keep consent granular, reversible, and recorded with policy version and timestamp evidence.
Design DSAR workflows with verification, ownership, deadlines, exceptions, and audit logs.
anti_patterns: Do not bundle unrelated consent purposes into one required choice.
Do not retain personal data without a documented period and deletion or anonymization path.
Do not treat example code as production-ready without security, legal, and system review.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and review prompts, but legal counsel should validate obligations and final decisions.

faq.question: Can it help with data subject requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers access, erasure, portability, verification, deadlines, exceptions, and response records.

faq.question: Does it include consent management guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes consent data models, preference UI patterns, audit logging, and withdrawal considerations.

faq.question: Can it scan my production system automatically?
faq.answer: No. It is a guidance skill and does not connect to databases, services, or live infrastructure.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare data categories, processing purposes, vendors, storage locations, retention needs, and existing privacy workflows.
